Joe Daly, in Malta, feeling like a dart board!
Hadley (Snr.), Bill Merryman, Sergeant Eilson, Len Herbert, Lawrie Jackson, Fred Bradman, Will Applebee, Dan Patience, Pat Ridge, Joe Daly (G.C.

Joe Daly from Malta G.C., sends his greetings to all Belgravians and will tell us all about it on his return home. Has increased his stride, and there have been times he could have won any Club handicap!

Joe Daly, from Malta G.C., writes: "Many thanks for the 'Mag. It's great; it revives memories of fellows who slapped the back of the last man home just as hard as the winners, of Socials—a little rough sometimes, but never lacking in spirit." Sidmouth and enjoying cruising around the English Coast. Joe Daly, we understand, is home on leave from Malta, G.M., but has failed to find his way to Wimbledon.
Joe Daly. The last heard of Joe was that he was home on leave from Malta, G.C.
